## Context / Problem

`tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py` cites "epic 3a03" in short,
four-hex form at lines 10, 13, and 414. In this repository `3a03` resolves to
`3a03-9863-542e-4ae1`, an unrelated closed bug about the `_no_repo_root_leaks` test-isolation
guard. A reader following the citation lands on the wrong ticket, so the provenance of the
ACLI contract-regression tests is effectively lost.

The verified source is the pre-extraction DSO epic `3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f` (closed, 24 children,
"level-triggered reconciler"), recorded in the DSO ticket-data mining report stored on the
tickets branch under `63cc-ec94-4792-464b`. Evidence for that attribution:

- The citations arrived verbatim in `b534f47a7f` ("Extract DSO ticket system + Jira reconciler
  into standalone rebar", 2026-06-08), so they name DSO ids, not rebar ids.
- The same file and `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli_graph.py` cite
  sibling DSO bug ids in full form (`c916-74a1-ed06-40e4`, `4fa9-0846-519e-4c30`,
  `5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b`); none of them resolve in the rebar store either.
- `3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f` is the only DSO-era id beginning `3a03` recorded anywhere in this
  repository's history, and it shares the prefix the author abbreviated.

The earlier hypothesis on this ticket that the source was rebar epic `3006-e198-13db-4e1f` is
disproved: `3006` was created 2026-07-03, a month after the citations landed in this
repository and six weeks after the 2026-05-24 ACLI audit they describe, and its plan never
mentions ACLI. Citing it would substitute one wrong reference for another.

## Approach

Rewrite the three short `epic 3a03` citations to the full DSO id `3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f`,
labelled as a pre-extraction DSO ticket so no reader mistakes it for the rebar ticket that now
owns the `3a03` prefix. This matches the full-id convention the surrounding code already uses
for the sibling DSO bug ids, and it needs no new lookup table or doc. The edits are inside a
module docstring and a comment banner only, so no test or assertion changes.

## Scope

- `tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py` — lines 10, 13, and 414: replace
  the short `epic 3a03` citation with `pre-extraction DSO epic 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f`. No
  executable line, fixture, assertion, or test name changes.

No other file changes. The sibling short form `bug c916` on line 409 is left alone: it does
not collide with any rebar ticket and its full id is already given on line 422.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grep -n "3a03" tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py` returns three
  lines, each containing the full id `3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f` and none containing a bare `3a03`
  short-form citation.
- [ ] Each of the three corrected citations identifies the id as a pre-extraction DSO ticket,
  verified by reading lines 10, 13, and 414.
- [ ] `git diff` for the change touches only comment and docstring lines in that one file,
  verified by inspecting the diff.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py`
  passes with the same collected test count as before the edit.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass in the worktree.
